milestones.title: The owner decides whether a classification@2 marking pattern may carry portion-marking brackets

remediation: The owner-confirmed marking pattern grammar of classification@1 (2026-11-25) is plain words: letters and digits, single spaces, - and /. A portion marking written (S) is therefore listed as the bare token S, which also matches any standalone capital S and can over-raise (the safe direction, which still costs people time). Decide with the owner whether a classification@2 marking pattern may carry the brackets of a portion marking, and until then list only portion tokens your organization's texts do not use as words. Source: 70.1-04 SUMMARY.
title: Portion markings such as (S) match only as bare tokens
